training.optimizer: batched reconstruction of historical per-coordinate AdaGrad, including the Cython raw-j variance lookup

deviation: The paper describes Text8 as a 17-million-token corpus, but the recovered author notebook trains on only its first 100,000 tokens. The independent trainer preserves the historical objective, initialization, pair construction, Cython gradient lookup, and AdaGrad rule, but batches independent updates in groups of 2048 instead of applying every ranking pair sequentially.
